svg.data-what: neurulation in cross-section, around day 21: the neural plate folds into the neural tube

path.data-what: the endoderm, the roof of the future gut; the lining of the gut and its glands will come from it

g.data-what: the coelom: the space opening between the two sheets of lateral plate mesoderm, the future body cavities
the lateral plate mesoderm, split in two sheets: the upper will make the body wall and limbs, the lower the heart, blood vessels and the gut's muscle
the intermediate mesoderm, a small cord on each side; the kidneys and gonads will come from it
the paraxial mesoderm, cut into somites on each side of the tube; vertebrae, ribs, back muscles and the dermis of the back will come from them

ellipse.data-what: the notochord, a rod of mesoderm under the neural tube; it signals to the tissues around it, and its remnant sits in the discs between vertebrae

g.data-what: the surface ectoderm, which will become the epidermis of the skin

path.data-what: the neural plate, folding into the neural tube; the brain and spinal cord will come from it

g.data-what: the neural folds, rising on each side and about to meet in the midline
neural crest cells, at the crest of each fold; they will leave and travel through the body to make pigment cells, nerves of the gut and the body, and the bones of the face
